title: NOS4A2
author: Hill, Joe
review:
Very entertaining and probably my favorite bit of Christmas themed horror that I have read so far. Some great characters and some really dark and messed up stuff that I loved.

I think it could have used some more thematic depth or was missing that extra oomph to tie it all together but I really enjoyed it from beginning to end. Joe Hill's dad does a little bit of a better job fleshing out characters and using a big page count effectively.

Joe Hill is now 2/2 for me and looking forward to reading more of his work.
